# TRL-EMIT-0007: Trigger pattern widened or dropped because GitHub has no equivalent syntax

- Severity: warning
- Exit class: none
- Area: EMIT
- Since: 0.1.0
- Status: active
- Fidelity: approximated

## Remediation

Review `params.pattern` and `params.action`; the trigger now fires on a superset of refs or paths.

## Example

```json
{"code": "TRL-EMIT-0007", "severity": "warning", "params": {"pattern": "<pattern>", "kind": "<kind>", "action": "<action>"}}
```
